children: Matthews International entered into a Ninth Amendment to its Third Amended and Restated Loan and Security Agreement to align credit terms with its post-divestiture structure. The amendment reduces the revolving credit capacity to $650 million and eliminates the unutilized foreign borrowing facility, releasing Matthews Europe from foreign borrower status. It also establishes a Covenant Relief Period through December 31, 2027, with stepped maximum leverage ratios, effectively accommodating the exclusion of the company’s 40% interest in the Propelis joint venture from the leverage calculation. Other material terms of the credit agreement remain unchanged.
